topic_match.reasoning: The question tests Unit Vectors: divide b by its magnitude, sqrt(8²+(-6)²)=10, to obtain (4/5,-3/5), which has unit length and the same direction (choice c).

question.problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=2t-1,\,\,\,y=2-{t}^{2},\,-3\le t\le 3.
$$
question.worked_solution:
We need to create a table of values and then sketch the curve. First, we work out the $x$-values using the formula $x=2t-1.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-7$ | $-5$ | $-3$ | $-1$ | $1$ | $3$ | $5$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y=2-{t}^{2}.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-7$ | $-5$ | $-3$ | $-1$ | $1$ | $3$ | $5$ |
| $y$ | $-7$ | $-2$ | $1$ | $2$ | $1$ | $-2$ | $-7$ |

$$

$$
